concerns.text: FR-003 (Monte Carlo 10k iterations) and SC-001 (proportion exceeding threshold) lack a completed implementation task. T029 is marked 'FAILED: unspecified' and T029b depends on it. Without a working Monte Carlo task, the core statistical engine and success criteria are unimplementable.

FR-005 (Sensitivity Analysis) and SC-003 (stability across thresholds) lack implementation tasks. T039a (config generation) and T039 (sweep logic) are unchecked. The spec requires sweeping {0.01%, 0.05%, 0.1%}, but no task exists to implement this logic or generate the required report.

Constitution Principle I (Reproducibility) and Principle V (Versioning) require a `--verify-reproducible` flag and fresh runner verification. T005 (logging with hash support) and T009a (GitHub Actions workflow) are unchecked/missing. The pipeline cannot satisfy the non-negotiable reproducibility gates.

FR-003 mandates a fallback to a permutation-based null model if Negative Binomial fit fails. T034 (fallback logic) is unchecked. T027 and T028 implement the models, but without T034, the system cannot satisfy the fallback requirement, risking pipeline failure on non-convergent data.

FR-007 requires findings to be framed as 'associational deviations'. T033 (framing logic in output reports) is unchecked. No task exists to implement the text generation or report formatting that enforces this constraint.

SC-006 (VIF calculation) requires checking predictors and flagging VIF > 5. T035 (VIF logic) is unchecked. No task exists to implement the diagnostic calculation or the 'Not Applicable' logic required by the spec.

SC-004 (Execution time < 6h) and SC-005 (Memory < 7GB) require verification. T048 (memory profiling) and T049 (time benchmarking) are unchecked. Without these tasks, the plan cannot produce the evidence artifacts required to satisfy these success criteria.

T014b appears twice: once for 'error handling' and once for 'Synthetic Data Fallback'. The duplicate ID 'T014b' creates ambiguity in traceability. One of these should be re-identified (e.g., T014e) to ensure distinct tasks map to distinct spec requirements.
